ruleset.name: RSS-Bridge PHPCompatibility
ruleset.description: PHP cross-version compatibility check for RSS-Bridge. Requires phpcompatibility/php-compatibility:^10.0.0@dev (PHPCS 4.x support). NewTrimCharactersDefault is excluded deliberately: the PHP 8.6 form-feed default for trim/ltrim/rtrim is desirable for scraped feed content, and repeating the default mask at every call site adds no value. The sniff self-disables once testVersion no longer spans PHP 8.5 and 8.6.
